description: Test support module for Telegram native commands, including mocks, utility functions, and test setup for command bot creation and command registration.

methods.name: waitForRegisteredCommands
methods.description: Waits for the setMyCommands mock to be called and returns the registered commands.

methods.name: resetNativeCommandMenuMocks
methods.description: Resets all mocks related to native command menu testing.

methods.name: createCommandBot
methods.description: Creates a mock command bot with command handlers and mocked API methods.

methods.name: createNativeCommandTestParams
methods.description: Creates test parameters for native command tests, including mocked dependencies.

methods.name: createPrivateCommandContext
methods.description: Creates a private command context for testing.
